reason: My bookkeeper and I already run everything through our expense app and it works well enough. I might let the bot read one group for the free 30 out of curiosity, but I'm not paying to move a whole year of site receipts into a new tool.
objection: This is a small new bot. If it shuts down in six months, my records are scattered between a Google Sheet and my old app, and I have to retrain the site guys and the bookkeeper all over again.
would_change_my_mind: If it sent clean data straight into Jurnal or Zoho, so it fills a gap instead of replacing my app, and I could see it had been running for other Bali contractors for a year or more.
